rules: Every provider not listed here is BLOCKED.
BLOCKED and UNVERIFIED providers can never make live calls.
External providers are off until the operator sets their enable flag, even when APPROVED.
CONDITIONAL providers also need every attestation flag set to true and any credential present.
A provider that has used its self-imposed quota stops; nothing paid is ever tried instead.
Personal data is sent only to providers whose allows_personal_data is true.

conditions: Development and test only; never answers chat, interview questions or interview scoring.

ollama.billing_risk: Ollama cloud models (names ending ':cloud' or '-cloud', or the ollama.com API) need an account and are not free; they are rejected.
conditions: LOCAL_MODEL_ENDPOINT must be a loopback address.
Model names ending in ':cloud' or '-cloud' are rejected.
OLLAMA_API_KEY must not be set.

sentence_transformers.billing_risk: none at runtime; model weights are downloaded once from the public Hugging Face Hub
conditions: Download weights during setup, then run with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 so runtime never reaches the network.

whisper_local.display_name: OpenAI Whisper, open-source model run locally
whisper_local.billing_risk: none locally. The hosted OpenAI transcription API is a different, paid service and is covered by 'openai'.
conditions: Use the open-source package only; never the hosted OpenAI audio API.

pymupdf.billing_risk: none, but it is AGPL: a hosted deployment must publish its source or buy a commercial licence
conditions: AGPL obligations must be met, or pdfplumber used instead.

web_speech_api.billing_risk: none to SkillBridge; by default the browser sends audio to its vendor's server
conditions: Prefer processLocally = true; use server recognition only after explicit user consent.
Always offer the typed-answer fallback.

gemini.billing_risk: A key from a project with billing linked is on a paid tier and is billed per token. The API cannot tell the app which tier a key is on.

rate_limits.published: Per model and per project; shown only in AI Studio. Exceeding them returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.

conditions: The key must come from an AI Studio project with no billing account linked (operator attests).
Unpaid Services terms: no sensitive, confidential or personal information, so no resume text.
Users must be 18 or older; not available to users in the EEA, UK or Switzerland on the free tier.
Free-tier prompts may be read by human reviewers and used to improve Google products.

github_rest_public.display_name: GitHub REST API, unauthenticated public data
github_rest_public.billing_risk: none: no account or credential, so there is no billing relationship. Over the limit returns 403/429.

rate_limits.published: 60 requests per hour per IP, unauthenticated

conditions: Cache responses; send no token.

arbeitnow.billing_risk: none: no key. Rate limits and attribution are not published.
conditions: Cache results; label listings with source and fetch date.

rate_limits.published: not stated in the part of the page read

conditions: Link back to Remote OK (followed link) and name it as the source, or access is suspended.
Do not use the Remote OK logo.

onjob_feed.display_name: OnJob.io public jobs feed (republishing live listings only)
onjob_feed.billing_risk: none: no key, no account and no fee ('no API key, no quota, no commercial fee').

rate_limits.published: none; the feed asks for a daily re-crawl

conditions: Use is limited to what the feed licence grants: crawl, cache and republish live listings, each linking to its OnJob.io url to apply.
No history after a listing closes, no vacancy counts, salary statistics, skill mining or forecasting from the feed: those need OnJob's written permission (docs/MARKET_DATA_SOURCES.md).
The general terms forbid automated access without written permission; the feed page is OnJob's published permission for the feed URLs only. No other OnJob page is fetched automatically.

jsearch.billing_risk: Marketplace plans; paid plans charge per request over quota. The free plan's hard limit could not be confirmed from the official page.
conditions: Blocked until the official pricing page confirms a hard-limited free plan with no card on file.

adzuna.billing_risk: Commercial use is only a 14-day trial, after which 'a licence agreement may be required'; aggregated statistics need written consent.
conditions: Could become CONDITIONAL for personal or academic research use with attribution, if the owner classifies the project that way.
US federal jobs only; of limited use to an India-focused product.

youtube_data_api.billing_risk: Quota is fixed (10,000 units/day; search.list 100 calls/day); the official pages read do not state that usage is free of charge.

coursera_api.billing_risk: unknown; no public developer terms were found

learning_provider_apis.billing_risk: unknown; each provider must be registered here on its own
conditions: Use the curated, linked learning resources in backend/src/seed instead.

public_datasets.display_name: Public job-market, salary and exam-syllabus datasets
public_datasets.billing_risk: Licence and provenance vary by dataset.
conditions: Each dataset needs its own entry with licence, source URL, publication date and retrieval date before use.

openai.billing_risk: Billed per token from prepaid credits; no free tier is relied on.

huggingface_inference.billing_risk: Free users get no monthly credits ('credits purchase required'); every request past included credits is charged.

ollama_cloud.billing_risk: Needs an ollama.com account and API key; plan limits and prices were not published on the page read.

google_vertex_ai.display_name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini through Google Cloud)
google_vertex_ai.billing_risk: Billed to a Google Cloud billing account. google-genai's Client() can select it from these variables when no API key is passed.
